page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a running head at the top; below the text a closing word "HOMIL.", then a woodcut ornament. No margin notes.

main_text.p: ternis diligentiús incumbunt, interiús à Domino sint magis alieni. Sed in primis illud memoriæ infigendum, cordis & corporis humilitatem ac reuerentiam Deo deberi: qui vtinam efficiat vt tam multa præclara & eximia documenta quæ hactenus audiuimus mentibus altiús hæreant infixa, & in vsum à nobis reuocentur, tantisper dum magni illius nostri Seruatoris Maiestatem coram inspiciamus, quum nos per exinanitionem suâ pro nobis in gloriam illam cœlestem in quam receptus est euexerit, vt cum vnà cum beatissimorum Angelorum choro perpetuis & meritis laudibus in æternum celebremus, Amen.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (a head with foliage and drapery) below the text; not transcribed. A stain on the left margin. The word "HOMIL." at the right is a closing catchline-style word, set apart from the text.
